executionClaim: No proposed test or operational exercise was executed for this planning deliverable.

scenarios.title: Current facts and selected scope
scenarios.preconditions: Current accepted task, refs, source decisions and historical parent observations.
scenarios.procedure: Read native refs and existing decisions; distinguish repaired, pending, superseded and unselected obligations.
scenarios.independentOracle: Pinned source/API observations plus actual owner scope, not a stale PR paragraph.
scenarios.expectedResult: No obsolete dependency repair or baseline-only deployment claim enters the plan.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Current scope table and evidence links.
scenarios.limitation: A scope read is not authority for a repository write.

scenarios.title: Source component qualification precedes adoption
scenarios.preconditions: A selected accepted source correction and its actual dependency closure.
scenarios.procedure: Inspect and run the relevant source regression and routed qualification before authorising its downstream candidate.
scenarios.independentOracle: Owning WP acceptance and independently specified failure/preservation assertion.
scenarios.expectedResult: Source failure blocks that component’s propagation; accepted prior unchanged evidence remains usable for its own scope.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Exact source commit, native tests and independent review.
scenarios.limitation: Other unrelated work need not wait.

scenarios.title: Three-way overlay conflict
scenarios.preconditions: Known per-file import B, selected U and current adopter D in owned fixtures.
scenarios.procedure: Apply the intended correction while D contains a relevant baseline/layout/command adaptation.
scenarios.independentOracle: Independently specified upstream fix and retained adopter behavior.
scenarios.expectedResult: Local overlay survives, or conflict is held; clean patch application alone is insufficient.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: B/U/D identities, diff, expected consumer outputs.
scenarios.limitation: No universal file synchronizer is being implemented.

scenarios.title: Generated configuration versus host loading
scenarios.preconditions: Approved setup delta and known generated-file consumer.
scenarios.procedure: Use existing generation/check entry, then observe actual host loading only where authorised.
scenarios.independentOracle: Expected generated files and the actual used host/tool boundary.
scenarios.expectedResult: Generation may pass while host qualification remains pending; unrelated configuration stays unchanged.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Before/after file identities and separate host evidence.
scenarios.limitation: Do not grant trust from a check command.

scenarios.title: Receipt freshness survives selected port
scenarios.preconditions: Actual writer/reader/schema set and an owned passing task fixture.
scenarios.procedure: Change source, configuration or required command identity; inspect the existing completion reader.
scenarios.independentOracle: Expected changed input and exact configured-command contract.
scenarios.expectedResult: Old success cannot qualify the altered object.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Original receipt, changed identity and actual rejection.
scenarios.limitation: No editing saved receipts or digests.

scenarios.title: Historical receipt and coherent format boundary
scenarios.preconditions: Selected WP1 v3 adoption with retained older evidence.
scenarios.procedure: Run the actual v3 reader against historical v2/current mismatched evidence, then execute a fresh valid run.
scenarios.independentOracle: Owning receipt contract and immutable before bytes.
scenarios.expectedResult: Old evidence remains historical; only proper new compatible evidence qualifies.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Preservation/readback and fresh native receipt.
scenarios.limitation: Not a new migration or compatibility fallback.

scenarios.title: Execution ownership in an adopter
scenarios.preconditions: WP2 actually accepted and selected; owned fixture checkouts.
scenarios.procedure: Reuse its controlled competing-start and linked-worktree lifecycle regressions through adopter paths.
scenarios.independentOracle: Exactly one owner per physical checkout; independent linked worktree evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: Existing ownership and failed histories survive; isolated checkouts can work independently.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Actual process outputs and task/evidence identities.
scenarios.limitation: Conditional on selecting the real WP2 implementation; do not exercise old user worktrees.

scenarios.title: Evidence snapshots stay out of product test discovery
scenarios.preconditions: Owned retained review snapshot and actual adopter test-discovery command.
scenarios.procedure: Inspect discovery under the approved archive/evidence placement; retain source inputs.
scenarios.independentOracle: Expected maintained test inventory, not snapshot filenames alone.
scenarios.expectedResult: No accidental duplicated suite or blanket evidence/input suppression.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Discovery output and preserved archive identities.
scenarios.limitation: Do not change global test ignores to hide failed tests.

scenarios.title: Explicit empty version is accepted at current owner
scenarios.preconditions: Independent valid VOWL fixture with header.version empty string.
scenarios.procedure: Pass through the actual projector and snapshot constructor.
scenarios.independentOracle: Current string-or-null contract; exact class/metadata expectation independently authored.
scenarios.expectedResult: Loadable inspection snapshot preserves empty string and expected entity.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Test output and source pin.
scenarios.limitation: Characterization if already passing; no mandated null rewrite.

scenarios.title: Absent version remains optional
scenarios.preconditions: Independently valid model without version plus a constructor-null case.
scenarios.procedure: Exercise actual projection/constructor.
scenarios.independentOracle: Expected optional metadata and unchanged entity/relationship facts.
scenarios.expectedResult: No invented version or rejection merely for absent metadata.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Native assertions and resulting record.
scenarios.limitation: Does not weaken other required fields.

scenarios.title: Explicit version Unicode/text preservation
scenarios.preconditions: Valid header with independently chosen nonempty Unicode/space-bearing version.
scenarios.procedure: Construct/project with actual owner functions.
scenarios.independentOracle: Exact supplied version text.
scenarios.expectedResult: Preserve meaningful bytes/text under the accepted string contract.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Expected versus actual value assertion.
scenarios.limitation: Do not normalize to make fixtures pass.

scenarios.title: Invalid typed header rejects at its boundary
scenarios.preconditions: Actual constructor fixture with number/object version or another invalid required header field.
scenarios.procedure: Invoke the real typed contract owner.
scenarios.independentOracle: Current type/field contract.
scenarios.expectedResult: Invalid constructor input rejects without making the whole header permissive.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Observed rejection and preserved neighboring positive case.
scenarios.limitation: Do not invent a stricter projector rule than accepted.

scenarios.title: Unexpected load failure is not cancellation
scenarios.preconditions: Valid current generation; no abort; existing injected dependency throws an uncoded TypeError.
scenarios.procedure: Invoke actual controller replacement/load path and public result.
scenarios.independentOracle: LOAD_FAILED behavior and independently expected retained state for that seam.
scenarios.expectedResult: Truthful failure, not LOAD_ABORTED; no fabricated new ontology success.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Public error and source/generation state assertions.
scenarios.limitation: No production failure-injection flag; private diagnostics stay private.

scenarios.title: Cancellation and supersession remain cancellation
scenarios.preconditions: Controlled pending load and actual accepted abort/supersession mechanism.
scenarios.procedure: Cancel and supersede using readiness barriers.
scenarios.independentOracle: Expected abort classification, winning generation and retained source.
scenarios.expectedResult: No stale completion overwrites current state; true abort does not become ordinary failure.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Execution order, public results and final state.
scenarios.limitation: Timing-only sleeps are not decisive race evidence.

scenarios.title: Coded fetch and parse failures keep their meaning
scenarios.preconditions: Known fetch and parse failures supplied through supported dependency boundary.
scenarios.procedure: Exercise actual catch/projection paths.
scenarios.independentOracle: Expected existing error code and usable previous-source policy.
scenarios.expectedResult: Error not reclassified as generic cancellation or false success.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Result plus generation/source assertions.
scenarios.limitation: Does not assert actual remote CORS behavior from a unit double.

scenarios.title: Failed replacement retains only the accepted graph
scenarios.preconditions: A visible accepted source and independently failing second replacement.
scenarios.procedure: Exercise failure before/after the relevant mount boundary using existing tests.
scenarios.independentOracle: Expected accepted generation/view and recovery result.
scenarios.expectedResult: Retained old graph is not reported as successful new load.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Source identity, state and test result.
scenarios.limitation: Broader renderer redesign is not authorised.

scenarios.title: Production bundle resolves shipped modules
scenarios.preconditions: Actual Vite configuration and existing productionBundle integration test.
scenarios.procedure: Run the maintained production-link regression and applicable retained old-external negative control.
scenarios.independentOracle: Native emitted module graph must resolve using shipped chunks.
scenarios.expectedResult: No bare unshipped D3 import; original build assets and approved hooks preserved.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Build/test output and unchanged-source/artifact observations.
scenarios.limitation: Module linking alone does not complete browser behavior.

scenarios.title: Native built-candidate AQFO job
scenarios.preconditions: Frozen actual built candidate, authorised native host and verified pinned source.
scenarios.procedure: Load, resolve person, inspect relations, frame, export, retrieve, parse/open and deliver actual SVG.
scenarios.independentOracle: Independent RDF/XML facts, actual view and independently opened artifact.
scenarios.expectedResult: Correct source-grounded result or truthful failure at the precise boundary.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Source/build/host identities, native results, SVG and delivery evidence.
scenarios.limitation: Honest failure is not positive product acceptance.

scenarios.title: Reject misleading artifact success
scenarios.preconditions: Owned diagnostic cases for HTML/missing Blob, wrong generation or best-effort layout.
scenarios.procedure: Apply the actual artifact consumer checks to the returned output.
scenarios.independentOracle: Media/XML/source/layout identity independently inspected.
scenarios.expectedResult: Wrong content never called SVG; timeout/best-effort never called settled; attachment gap explicit.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Original failed output and diagnostic.
scenarios.limitation: No generated replacement diagram.

scenarios.title: Current native dependency result
scenarios.preconditions: Exact current PR target and all relevant workflow family observations.
scenarios.procedure: Inspect dependency action and exact attempt; compare historical failure/repair/new result.
scenarios.independentOracle: Actual job/step identity and current scope.
scenarios.expectedResult: Latest observed native pass recorded without reopening old repair; new failure remains held.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Run/attempt/job and decision reference.
scenarios.limitation: Pass on a prior candidate is historical.

scenarios.title: Comparator retirement preserves historical evidence
scenarios.preconditions: Accepted retirement, historical report and four retained providers.
scenarios.procedure: Inspect preserved history/current source; reuse or rerun applicable equivalence verification under authority.
scenarios.independentOracle: Original historical bytes and independently retained 200-result subset/corpus.
scenarios.expectedResult: Retired executable not restored; historical 250 results not labelled fresh current output.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Report/source identities and consumer disposition.
scenarios.limitation: Recovery installation is not active tooling.

scenarios.title: Installed archive rather than development source
scenarios.preconditions: Approved exact .tgz and independent consumer outside source ancestry.
scenarios.procedure: Use native package consumer/install; inspect resolved API/CLI and installed graph.
scenarios.independentOracle: Exact archive identity and expected package paths/content.
scenarios.expectedResult: Missing packed file or source-link fallback is detected; actual installed graph retained.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Archive hash, install/resolution and package-content evidence.
scenarios.limitation: No unapproved registry publishing or global install.

scenarios.title: Real-description API semantics
scenarios.preconditions: Actual accepted description bytes, profile and independent expectations.
scenarios.procedure: Convert with installed public API and inspect required literals, structure and diagnostics.
scenarios.independentOracle: Source/registry-grounded expected semantic details, not generated output as oracle.
scenarios.expectedResult: Required behavior and declared loss preserved; unknown real input remains pending.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Input identity, output, diagnostics and assertions.
scenarios.limitation: Does not require an unaccepted universal round trip.

scenarios.title: Installed CLI and declared types
scenarios.preconditions: Same archive/real input and supported selected compiler; actual CLI help contract.
scenarios.procedure: Run installed CLI, invalid-input control and applicable generated-declaration consumer.
scenarios.independentOracle: Accepted API/CLI/type contract and actual process result.
scenarios.expectedResult: Expected output and truthful status; installed declarations usable without undeclared source path.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Commands/results, output identity and compiler/runtime.
scenarios.limitation: No invented CLI switches or replaced compiler role.

scenarios.title: New dependency failure cannot be suppressed for adoption
scenarios.preconditions: An actual new advisory/gate failure or an explicitly labelled policy exercise.
scenarios.procedure: Apply the existing dependency decision route.
scenarios.independentOracle: Exact native scope/threshold and accountable accepted disposition.
scenarios.expectedResult: No blanket scope/severity lowering or prior-advisory exemption.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Failure, decision and required new verification.
scenarios.limitation: A policy exercise is not a live dependency finding.

scenarios.title: Local delivery is not remote publication
scenarios.preconditions: Current local-only or separately bounded publication authority.
scenarios.procedure: Review proposed archive, rendering, PR/CI and destination actions.
scenarios.independentOracle: Actual scope/permission decision.
scenarios.expectedResult: Local results remain usable; unauthorised pushes/dispatches/publication are not performed.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Handoff with action-specific authority and limits.
scenarios.limitation: Past authorised push is not future blanket permission.

scenarios.title: Combined integration admission
scenarios.preconditions: Real MCP/SHACL owner handoffs and accepted source context.
scenarios.procedure: Inspect readiness and bind exact implementation identities.
scenarios.independentOracle: Actual accepted implementations, not a proposal branch or untracked file count.
scenarios.expectedResult: Missing side/authority yields named pending integration; no invented merged SHA.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Input/owner table and next event.
scenarios.limitation: Independent product/adoption work can continue.

scenarios.title: Staged and context-specific SHACL input
scenarios.preconditions: Accepted implemented staged/context contract and owned differing staged/working fixture.
scenarios.procedure: Validate the selected actual source context through native entry.
scenarios.independentOracle: Independent source bytes/context and expected valid/violating case.
scenarios.expectedResult: No silent working-file substitution or mixed release context.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Input/object IDs, command and focused result.
scenarios.limitation: Conditional on the accepted SHACL contract, not activation of draft policy.

scenarios.title: Context graph, audit scope and target count
scenarios.preconditions: Accepted changed-only/full-audit rules and independently authored cross-module/legacy fixtures.
scenarios.procedure: Exercise conforming, cross-file violation, untouched legacy and zero-target/unavailable cases.
scenarios.independentOracle: Accepted rule/focus-node expectations from independent source facts.
scenarios.expectedResult: Scope and conformance reported truthfully; zero targets or unavailable graph not universal pass.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Native reports, target scope and data/policy identities.
scenarios.limitation: Meta-SHACL and second-engine checks keep their distinct claims.

scenarios.title: Validated source reaches actual MCP consumer
scenarios.preconditions: Combined accepted code, explicit data context and current generated/query artifacts.
scenarios.procedure: Trace an independently selected fact through validation, build/index and native MCP request.
scenarios.independentOracle: Independent entity/relationship fact and artifact source identities.
scenarios.expectedResult: Correct selected fact served; stale/missing artifact fails or remains explicit supported limitation.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Source, output and MCP consumer result.
scenarios.limitation: Starting a server or missing-only generator exiting zero is insufficient.

scenarios.title: Real combined R2 qualification
scenarios.preconditions: Final actual combined candidate and approved verification configuration.
scenarios.procedure: Run actual required full profile plus accepted SHACL/MCP/independent consumers.
scenarios.independentOracle: Owning accepted baseline and concrete product semantics.
scenarios.expectedResult: Required executed checks cover actual object; synthetic full fixture cannot substitute.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Native receipt/raw outputs, semantic reports and reviewer.
scenarios.limitation: No release, Wiki or remote channel publication authority.

scenarios.title: Combined identity movement invalidates earlier evidence
scenarios.preconditions: Owned combined-state fixture with a legitimate passing receipt.
scenarios.procedure: Move relevant source, baseline or controls; exercise actual existing gate and consumer.
scenarios.independentOracle: Independently known changed identity.
scenarios.expectedResult: Incompatible branch/earlier evidence rejected; original history intact.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Before/after identity and rejection/current verification.
scenarios.limitation: Do not reset task lineage or manually refresh digests.

scenarios.title: Per-adopter effective host claim
scenarios.preconditions: Actual selected host, runtime, plugin/guard and approved scope.
scenarios.procedure: Exercise required adopted entry and supported guard/security/writer obligations or reuse exactly applicable evidence.
scenarios.independentOracle: Actual loaded/invoked identity and existing WP4/WP5 acceptance.
scenarios.expectedResult: Only observed scope is claimed; UI visibility/source merge not a capability pass.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Host/tool identities, raw results and explicit gaps.
scenarios.limitation: No guard-disable test or unsafe destructive negative control.

scenarios.title: Trusted policy and remote attempt identity
scenarios.preconditions: Approved trusted-consumer update and subsequent qualifying event where in scope.
scenarios.procedure: Read policy checkout, PR base/head, tested object, event/run/attempt and all relevant job families.
scenarios.independentOracle: Native workflow metadata/logs and accepted trusted-policy revision.
scenarios.expectedResult: Candidate policy not used to approve itself; product-green does not hide failed linkage.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Exact policy/product revisions, jobs and remaining failure.
scenarios.limitation: Rerun of old event does not implicitly load new default-branch policy.

scenarios.title: Failed propagation and compatible recovery
scenarios.preconditions: Owned test/example delta with a failing adopted contract and retained prior state.
scenarios.procedure: Exercise decision and bounded authorised forward-fix/revert procedure without deleting runtime.
scenarios.independentOracle: Known selected change and writer/reader compatibility obligations.
scenarios.expectedResult: Propagation stops; failed evidence/active ownership survive; incompatible old reader remains a hold.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Failure, preserved state, decision and requalification.
scenarios.limitation: No hard reset or blanket rollback.

scenarios.title: Evidence retrieval and outstanding resource ownership
scenarios.preconditions: Required bundles/resources, receiving maintainer and approved retained store.
scenarios.procedure: Read back required retained content; inspect held consumers/nested/guard-blocked disposition.
scenarios.independentOracle: Actual content identities and receiving-owner acknowledgement.
scenarios.expectedResult: Resources remain if preservation/release unresolved; next actor/event visible after task completion.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Readback, existing adoption/handoff and resource obligations.
scenarios.limitation: Manifest or checksum alone is not recoverability; no deletion required.

operationalExercises.title: UO source and real combined integration
operationalExercises.requiredObservation: Actual accepted implementations/context, final combined full and semantic consumer evidence; missing implementation remains pending.

operationalExercises.title: WebVOWL actual AQFO artifact
operationalExercises.requiredObservation: Native built-candidate source-grounded job, actual independently inspected SVG and exact delivery outcome.

operationalExercises.title: ONI real installed description consumer
operationalExercises.requiredObservation: Current dependency disposition and actual real-input archive/API/CLI/type/rendering scope.

operationalExercises.title: Selective adopter and receiving-maintainer handoff
operationalExercises.requiredObservation: Each selected adopter can identify its fix, overlays, actual host evidence, retrieval and next actor.
